hooks.command: { f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); r="${f#"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/}"; case "$r" in packages/*|scripts/*|evaluation/*|.github/*|docs/*|.graph/project.json|package.json|tsconfig.base.json|eslint.config.mjs|README.md|CONTRIBUTING.md) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown --log-level warn "$r" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
